Delhi Laxmi Yojana Form 2026 – Full Details

Delhi Laxmi Yojana has started the online registration process for the Delhi Lakshmi Yojana from 1 August 2026. Under this scheme, eligible women will receive ₹2,500 financial assistance every month. According to the government, more than 17 lakh women are expected to benefit from the scheme. If you are also planning to apply, it is important to know the eligibility criteria, required documents, and application rules beforehand so that you can complete the registration process correctly and without any difficulty.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 01 August 2026
  • Last Date : N/A
  • Candidates are advised to verify the details from the official Delhi Lakshmi Yojana website.

Application Fee

  • No Application Fee

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

  • Apply Online
  • Download Notification
